Model mix & pricing qualification
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@brightlayer.com>, Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Model mix & pricing qualification - BrightLayer

Thanks for the time earlier today - good conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we can size a concrete pricing recommendation: 

Recap (high level)
- Use cases: chat-based agent for customer support (primary), embeddings for semantic search and recommendations, and a small rerank step for surfacing responses.
- Target latency: sub-300ms p95 for chat (hosted preferred to start).
- Security: SOC2 + VPC peering on roadmap (procurement will reach out).

Asks / info we need to finalize a blended pricing estimate:
1) Monthly volumes per model type (or percent mix + total tokens):
   - Chat (text gen) tokens/month
   - Embeddings: calls/month and desired vector size (or approx tokens equivalent if you track that)
   - Rerank: tokens/month and average candidate set size
2) Target unit economics / acceptable $ per 1M tokens (or target spend band) - helps us choose hosted vs dedicated pricing paths
3) Budget cadence: monthly / annual commit and any procurement lead times

We put a very rough initial estimate in the attached initial_estimate_v1.xlsx - please don't treat as final. If you can reply with the per-model volumes and a ballpark budget range, I'll produce a short, two-line pricing summary (hosted vs dedicated) plus a recommended rollout plan.

Thanks -
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial_estimate_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub: model mix assumptions + placeholder unit pricing)

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@brightlayer.com>, BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing qualification - BrightLayer

Hi Marissa - thanks for the recap and for the worksheet. Here are the numbers we have today (rough):

- Total expected token-equivalent volume: ~60M tokens/month (growth to 120M in 6-9 months if adoption goes well)
- Model mix (approx):
  * Chat (customer-facing): 70% of tokens (~42M tokens/month today)
  * Embeddings (semantic search & recommender): ~25% - we measure embeddings by calls not tokens; currently ~200k calls/month (vector dim 768)
  * Rerank / post-filtering: ~5% (~3M tokens/month)

Budget / unit economics:
- Internal target: $8 / 1M tokens (this is what product finance has been using as a target for hosted costs)
- Monthly budget band for initial pilot: $7k- $15k / month (we can scale and consider commit if numbers make sense)

Procurement: procurement@brightlayer.com is looped in; lead time likely 3-5 weeks for a standard SaaS MSA + DPA.

Let me know if you need more granularity (e.g., avg prompt+reply tokens for chat). Happy to pull logs if that helps accuracy.

- Sarah
Sarah Jones
Product Owner, BrightLayer
Sarah.Jones@brightlayer.com

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing qualification - BrightLayer

Thanks Sarah - this is extremely helpful. A few follow-ups so we can convert your numbers into a clean hosted vs dedicated comparison: 

1) One more datapoint on embeddings: are those 200k calls/month single-vector lookups (i.e., 1 vector per call) or multi-vector ops (N vectors per call)? Also, do you have a target recall/latency SLA for the search path?

2) For chat, can you confirm average prompt+response token length (ballpark is fine). If you don't have that, we can use industry defaults (prompt 50 tokens / response 150 tokens) but we'd rather be accurate for unit economics.

3) On the $8 / 1M tokens target - thanks for the transparency. We can run two scenarios:
   - Hosted (no commit): likely blended $/1M in the $7-12 range depending on model selection and quantization.
   - Dedicated (1-2 year commit): with full embedding + chat traffic concentrated we can get to $3-6 / 1M tokens equivalent depending on GPU class and batch sizing.

I'll attach an updated sheet (redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx) with the math for both scenarios and three recommended model mixes (conservative: more efficient models + quantized; balanced: quality-first; aggressive: quality + larger models).

If you're open to it, next steps:
- You share a short sample of avg chat token lengths (or allow us to use logs)
- I send a 1-page hosted vs dedicated economics memo + recommended model mix for pilot (will include suggested trial discounts + suggested SLOs)

Looping Marcus and Neha for quick pricing & infra sanity check before I send the memo to procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx (stub: scenario math + model mix recommendations)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>

Marissa - quick internal note:
- Given the 60M starting token volume and 70/25/5 model mix, I agree we can present a blended hosted price around $7-9 / 1M for the pilot to stay within their $7k- $15k band. Offer a 6-month introductory blended rate of $6 / 1M with a 1.2x uplift if they don't commit to a 12-month minimum after pilot. 
- If they commit to 12 months and get to 120M tokens, recommend dedicated options that target $3.5-5 / 1M.

I'll review the attached sheet and flag if any kernel/hardware constraints change those estimates, but this aligns with recent deals. Happy for you to send the memo to BrightLayer.

- Marcus
